description: A finite-arity relation has computably enumerable complement if and only if it is \(\Pi_1\)-definable in the standard natural numbers.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.coenumerable_iff_piOne {n : ℕ} (R : (Fin n → ℕ) → Prop) :
  (REPred fun x => ¬R x) ↔ Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.ArithmeticDefinability.PiOneDefinable R
